# MAAI Property Care

> MAAI Property Care is a real estate consultancy in Sector 89, Gurgaon (Gurugram), Haryana, India. We help people buy, rent, sell and manage property in Gurgaon: affordable homes, luxury residences, commercial spaces and plots. Tagline: "Your Property, Our Responsibility."

## Services
- Buy: help finding and buying homes, plots and commercial property in Gurgaon.
- Rent: help finding a home or commercial space to rent.
- Sell / resale: help selling or reselling your property.
- Let your property: help finding tenants for your Gurgaon property.
- Property management and care: looking after your property, including for owners who live in another city or abroad.

## Property types
- Affordable homes
- Luxury residences
- Commercial spaces (offices, shops)
- Plots

## How we work
- One point of contact from the first question to the final decision.
- Fees and scope of service are agreed during the consultation, before you proceed.
- We encourage clients to verify title, approvals and the HRERA project record before committing.

- Which areas do you serve? Gurgaon (Gurugram), Haryana.
- Can you manage my property if I live elsewhere? Yes, property care for owners who live away is one of our services.
